body: The linked issue #3892 carries no priority label, so this PR cannot carry one. Please set the issue's P label (parent #3663 is P4) so the sweep can copy it.

The account that filed #3892 (qsmits) is not a collaborator, so it cannot set labels on issues. Please set P4 on #3892, as on the parent #3663, and the effort label. The same applies to the other new sub-issues of #3663: #3893 to #3898 (see the request in the #3663 comment).

<!-- pr-reviewer: be7168455d8eb57c67959c6048b56b1b0caed8ae -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

I read the whole diff against current upstream main and checked the current project laws. This is the first review.

The window keeps the Properties subject. Add and Import use the existing commands. Saved layouts remove the retired tab and its empty float. The PR includes before/after screenshots. I opened both images and checked the layout. No snapshot PNG changes.

NeoTech's request for a priority label is met. Issue #3892 and this PR now have P4.
